query:
SELECT m.id AS "id!"
        FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS m(id)
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM email_effective_message_labels ml
            JOIN email_labels l ON l.id = ml.label_id
            WHERE ml.message_id = m.id AND l.link_id = $2 AND l.provider_label_id = $3
        ) <> $4
